interpretations.text: Cancellation entries materially reduce the positive recorded sales value. They should be reviewed as a separate accounting stream rather than assumed to be matched product returns.
Missing customer identifiers limit customer-level analyses, while the corresponding valid transaction values remain usable in country and monthly reporting.
Repeated source fields affect the recorded-value estimate. Deduplication is a documented analytical assumption, and the excluded amount provides a sensitivity measure.

recommendations.text: Investigate the highest-value cancellation invoices alongside the original records before drawing conclusions about operational causes.
Compare complete overlapping months when assessing trends; exclude the partial final month from full-month growth claims.
Report deduplication sensitivity and customer-coverage limitations alongside any commercial recommendation.
